en: Black‑and‑white aerial view of a narrow valley settlement with dense forested hills on both sides. A river runs through the foreground, crossed by an arched bridge for pedestrians and vehicles. Parallel to the river is a curving railway line with several train cars and industrial buildings including a tall smokestack. Residential houses and small gardens line the road and tracks. Printed caption text appears in the lower left corner of the image.
